caption: The drawing depicts a carved wooden statue of a standing figure, positioned on a black rectangular pedestal. The figure has dark brown skin, long black hair, and wears a gold headband with a large tan feather plume on top. It is dressed in a bright green tunic with gold trim, a gold necklace, and a red cloak that is also edged in gold. The figure’s arms are extended forward, with the left arm bent at the elbow and the right arm slightly outstretched, both hands open as if to hold or present something. The legs are clothed in brown garments with gold detailing, and the sandals are brown, matching the base color of the statue. The background is plain and unadorned, with the artist's name "Alvin M. Gully" and the year "1941" inscribed beneath the pedestal.
title: Cigar Store Indian
